item.description: New Delhi: Former litigant in the Babri Masjid case, Iqbal Ansari, said on Saturday that peace and communal harmony now define Ayodhya, nearly three decades after the demolition of the Babri Masjid. item.title: IndiGo fiasco: Indian Railways deploys 116 extra coaches across 37 trains
item.description: New Delhi: Keeping the widespread flight cancellations in mind amid IndiGo fiasco, a total of 37 trains have been augmented with 116 additional coaches, operating over 114 augmented trips across the country, according to Indian Railways. Southern Railway leads capacity boost with 18 train augmentations Southern Railway (SR) has carried out the highest number of augmentations, enhancing capacity in 18 trains. Additional Chair Car and Sleeper Class coaches have been deployed on high-demand routes.

item.title: Illegal cattle trafficking: Container truck carrying over 100 cattle seized in Odisha’s Balasore
item.description: Balasore: In a major crackdown on illegal cattle trafficking, Odisha Police on Saturday rescued over 100 cattle from a container truck moving from Bhadrak to West Bengal. Two members of an alleged cattle trafficking network were detained, and the truck was seized. item.title: Odisha rolls out Mukhyamantri Kanya Bibaha Yojana: Know eligibility criteria and other details
item.description: Bhubaneswar: The Odisha Government has rolled out the Mukhyamantri Kanya Bibaha Yojana, a new welfare scheme offering Rs 51,000 in marriage assistance to eligible brides from economically weaker families. The marriage aid scheme aims to ensure dignified, culturally respectful, and legally compliant marriages across the state.
